panels.title: CPU Sampled Flame Graph
panels.description: Sampled CPU folded stacks pushed by WCCKIT as pprof sample-count profiles. This is sampled CPU time, not a complete call trace. Function/source clarity depends on runtime symbol support, debug symbols, frame pointers, and Python perf-map support.

options.content:
CPU profiles are sampled. Source-code links and line-level names only appear when the target runtime and binaries expose enough symbol information. For Python targets, starting the workload with `python3 -X perf` improves stack naming where supported.

The uflow panel is an entry-event call tree derived from the complete uflow archive. WCCKIT stores the tree in Pyroscope as a sample-count pprof profile labelled `profile_type=uflow`; read it as event counts, not CPU time.

panels.title: Application uflow Entry Call Tree
panels.description: Folded entry-event call tree derived from the complete raw BCC uflow archive and pushed as a pprof sample-count profile. This is not sampled CPU time; return events remain preserved in JSONL but are not counted as stack samples.

panels.title: Profile Push Status

targets.query: from(bucket: "wcckit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_profile_status") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pushed" or r._field == "exit_code") |> last()

panels.description: Last Pyroscope push status. pushed=1 means WCCKIT pushed a folded profile successfully; exit_code=0 means helper success.

panels.title: uflow Event Preservation Summary

targets.query: from(bucket: "wcckit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_app_uflow_summary") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "events_total" or r._field == "parsed_events_total" or r._field == "entry_events_total" or r._field == "return_events_total" or r._field == "unparsed_events_total" or r._field == "folded_stacks_total") |> last()

panels.description: Run-level uflow parser counts. Entry events feed the call-tree flame graph; return and unparsed rows remain preserved in JSONL.
